nota: Storyboard v2 by team Stellar Experience. AI-generated illustrations for validation.

cuadros.narracion: The Peruvian astronaut flies the ship toward the Moon. From the console you see the destination for the first time.
cuadros.dialogo: "Train to run a base on the Moon and Mars."

cuadros.narracion: The astronaut checks the route with the mission guide. Four stops connect the Moon with Mars.
The astronaut inspects the battery and the air system. The guide points to the auxiliary equipment.
cuadros.dialogo: "When there is no light, the battery will keep the air running."

cuadros.narracion: The player adjusts the plan and sees how much reserve is left before simulating.
cuadros.dialogo: "Will the battery last until dawn with this plan?"

cuadros.narracion: The astronaut reviews the first plan in the Chronoscope. The battery is empty and the fan stopped on turn 3.
cuadros.dialogo: "The battery ran out before dawn." Context: "Your plan left the auxiliary equipment on." Action: "Rewind and adjust."

cuadros.narracion: Same scene with the adjusted plan. The air lasts until dawn. The reserve that carries over to M2 is confirmed.
cuadros.dialogo: "You saved energy to keep the air running." "What did you stop using to make it?"

cuadros.narracion: The astronaut checks the tank and the recycler with the reserve saved in the first mission.
cuadros.dialogo: "Air needs energy. Recovering water costs energy too."

cuadros.narracion: Share energy with the air and choose when to recycle. The Chronoscope shows the water dropping if you wait, or the battery dropping if you turn it on.
cuadros.dialogo: "If you wait to recycle, you will use more water from the tank."

cuadros.narracion: The astronaut writes down which resource was tightest and what they would do differently.
cuadros.dialogo: "What did you protect first? What ended with the smallest reserve?"

cuadros.narracion: The pilot cat announces the arrival. The console shows the Mars inventory and brings back the lunar note as a reminder.
cuadros.dialogo: "New base. Before you decide, check your reserves."

cuadros.narracion: A dust storm lowers power generation. The player shares out the energy. The lamps light up and the expected harvest changes.
cuadros.dialogo: "More energy for the crops leaves less for later."

cuadros.narracion: The astronaut leads the harvest and prepares the reserves for the next mission.
cuadros.dialogo: "This harvest stays for the next mission."

cuadros.narracion: The astronaut gets a solar alert by radio. They must decide which area to shield and whether to wait for Earth.
cuadros.dialogo: "Earth hasn't answered yet. Do you start preparing the shelter?"

cuadros.narracion: The Chronoscope compares protection and the time available. Waiting brings confirmation but uses up time. The player can rewind.
cuadros.dialogo: "You got the answer. Now you have less time to prepare the shelter."

cuadros.narracion: The shelter brings the crew together once a workable plan is confirmed. The player explains what they protected and what cost they accepted.
cuadros.dialogo: "What did you protect, and what would you change if there were less time?"

cuadros.narracion: The astronaut closes the journal with the little llama and a vicuña from Moquegua. Both mascots go with the card about high-Andean wildlife.
cuadros.dialogo: "Your journal." Sections "What you decided" and "What you learned".
